claims.text: Masked Document Generation (MDG) is a task that learns to recover a document with a masked span of tokens, where a segment of the document is randomly selected and masked to predict the original content.

In MDG, the length of the masked span is sampled from a uniform distribution, and the masking strategy involves replacing tokens in the selected span with a special token, although this is avoided in practice for certain reasons.
MDG is one of the three pre-training tasks used in the STEP model for improving performance in abstractive summarization.
